query: select jsonb_build_object('migration_head',(select max(version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'tables',(select from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('public.crm_leads'::regclass,'public.crm_lead_history'::regclass,'public.tasks'::regclass))) as retirement_catalog;
